data.name: Akili
data.gender_notes: Akili is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Akil' meaning wise, clever, and intelligent. In Islamic history, Akili is a name given to individuals who possess deep wisdom and understanding. The name Akili carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akili usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be wise and knowledgeable in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Akili belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akili total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
